Definition: from G1909 and (the accusative case plural neuter of) G1565; upon those parts of, i.e. on the further side of:--beyond.
BiblicalUsage: Epekeina means beyond, on the further side. Stephen quotes Amos against Israel: you took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and I will carry you away beyond Babylon. Beyond is where judgment sends them — further than they ever meant to go.
TheologicalSignificance: Idolatry always carries you further from home than you planned, and beyond Babylon is the proof of it.
